_comment: Explicit ABK-type witness candidate: unit charges at e1,e2,e3, charges q=4367/1000000 at (1/3,1/3,1/3) +- (17/200)(1,1,1) = (251/600 and 149/600 on the diagonal). Rational embedding of the arXiv:2607.27197 five-charge configuration (their eps = 3t/sqrt(2) ~ 0.1803; q matches their charge law to ~2e-8).
